items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: One time Carl was knocking off the band and instead of me playing, I was sitting there asleep. So Carl let me go;

ctx.x: Working at the shipyard everyday and getting home at six o'clock at night and had to be at work at eight and work until one o'clock in the morning.

One time Carl was knocking off the band and instead of me playing, I was sitting there asleep. So Carl let me go; he said it was better if you go because it was too much for you working daytime and night too. It tickled me (laughter).
Like burning the candle at both ends.
